races.name: Human
races.description: The most common and adaptable people, found in every corner of the world.

traits.name: Versatility
traits.description: You begin with one additional tag skill.

traits.name: Ambition
traits.description: You gain one bonus perk at 1st level.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Graceful, long-lived people with a deep connection to nature and magic.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 18 meters.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You resist charm and mind-affecting magic, and cannot be magically put to sleep.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Sturdy, industrious folk carved from the mountain stone itself.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light, out to 18 meters.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You resist poison and disease, taking reduced damage from both.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small, cheerful folk who make the most of life's simple pleasures.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: Once per day, when a check would critically fail (a fumble), you may reroll and keep the new result.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You resist fear and intimidation effects.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.
